mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate indicates tight monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which negatively impacts equity returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in unemployment rate signals economic weakness, leading to negative equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive when UNRATE increases beyond threshold in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong consumer demand, boosting equity markets.
failure_condition: Negative 60-day returns occur in >30% of periods with rising HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing industrial production growth signals supply chain issues, leading to negative equity returns.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns occur in >40% of periods with slowing INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment with increasing unemployment indicates labor market inefficiencies, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in >30% of cases where both proxies increase.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high FEDFUNDS signals tightening, leading to negative equity returns.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in >40% of periods with high FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth with high inflation may lead to rate hikes, causing negative equity returns.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns occur in >30% of cases meeting the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing real consumer spending boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive equity returns.
failure_condition: Negative 5-day returns occur in >40% of periods with rising RSAFS.
